notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary regional interaction routing surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies regional publication, overlapping and disjoint subscriptions, subscription removal and restoration, receive-order interaction payload and tag delivery, producer and transportation metadata, conveyed source-region designators, and independent region and federation cleanup without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional interaction publication, subscription, unsubscription, send, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction delivery
